name: Knob Noster State Park
story: Pin Oak Slough Natural Area is a four-acre section of Knob Noster State Park in Missouri, United States. It is a wet-mesic forest and shrub swamp located in a former oxbow slough of Clearfork Creek. Water pools there during spring to form vernal pools.
matters: The area shelters the rare pale green orchid. Trees growing in the natural area include pin oak, swamp white oak, bur oak, and silver maple.
